items.title: Smallholder Farmers Face ‘Polycrisis’ from El Niño, Unreliable Irrigation and Rising Costs
items.summary: Cambodian farmers who lost crops to drought this summer and then to floods that damaged roughly 5% of the country’s wet-season rice now face a prolonged El Niño expected to stretch the dry season into next year.
